data.description:
Implement Option A: harden the two-tier flow into a ruleset-enforced, fail-closed review gate.

Source of truth: docs/handoff/option-a-pivot-plan.md (CONVERGED, review #1-6 + experiments V0.1-V0.12) and docs/adr/0020-two-tier-hardening-over-merge-queue.md. This epic translates plan Phase 2 (§5) + the review-#4/#6 prerequisites into shippable phases. Do NOT use /dso:sprint (the plan was produced by a different process).

NON-NEGOTIABLE REQUIREMENT: every commit reaching `main` must pass an LLM review that is ruleset-enforced (a hard GitHub gate), not merely flow-enforced — and the enforcing checks must fail-closed (never silently green on a precondition/token/expiry failure).

DELIVERY PRINCIPLES (build so surprises surface fast and we can course-correct):
- Warn-first: every story ships its enforcing logic in warn/advisory mode and is validated on live PR2 traffic BEFORE any enforce-flip. The single enforce-flip (final story) is the only hard-to-reverse step and is hard-gated.
- Live-verify each story on real GitHub (admin PAT: provision/read; non-admin: containment reads) AND by the named E-series/V-series experiments.
- Each story names a COURSE-CORRECTION TRIGGER: the observable that, if seen, means stop and re-plan rather than push on.
- Reversibility: warn-mode checks are advisory (no team impact); the enforce-flip story carries the runbook (land the swap with no other PR2 in flight — R8 RED is repo-wide during the live<->file skew window).

SUCCESS CRITERIA (epic closes only when ALL are met + completion-verifier PASS):
- SC1 (single fail-closed gate): a single always-runs required check `review-gate` exists that runs on every base==main PR (no code_changed skip) and fail-closes unless every SHA in origin/main..head is proven reviewed (per-SHA coverage). Verified live: an allowlisted-only PR2 carrying un-reviewed content is BLOCKED (not skip-to-success). [E2/E13]
- SC2 (no silent pass): all review-enforcing CI wrappers fail-closed on precondition/token failure under enforce mode. Verified: a scope-stripped/expired token makes the gate RED (not exit-0) in ALL THREE carriers — review-coverage-invariant.yml, dangling-references.yml, ruleset-invariants.yml. [V0.3a-post-fix, R8 fail-closed]
- SC3 (live ruleset enforces it, durably): live `main` ruleset requires `review-gate` and retains `llm-review`; the merge-pipeline-checks->review-gate swap is reflected on BOTH required-checks.txt and the live ruleset; the R8 live-parity guard fail-closes under enforce so PAT expiry/scope-strip/drift cannot silently disable it. [E6', V0.11]
- SC4 (no false wedge): a clean fully-reviewed PR2 passes; a commit whose diff is entirely within the event-sourced ticket store is exempt and does not wedge; the coverage ledger warm-hits across re-runs (no flaky-check team block). [E5/E8/E14/E15]
- SC5 (instruction surfaces reviewable): behavior-bearing surfaces (docs/**, skills, behavior-driving config) are removed from the review-gate allowlist and become reviewable; genuinely-inert artifacts (images, lockfiles, generated) and the ticket store remain exempt. Verified: a docs-only PR now requires review; an image/lockfile PR still skips. [E11/E-compute-hash]
- SC6 (flow preserved + documented): the two-tier flow is retained and its UX correctness fixes land (descriptive PR1 titles; sprint draft-umbrella lifecycle); docs reflect the final enforced architecture; ADR-0020 updated with execution results.

SEQUENCING: stories 1-4 may proceed in parallel after start; story 5 depends on 1+2+4; story 6 depends on 5; story 7 (enforce-flip) depends on 1-6 ALL verified; story 8 (UX) is independent and may land any time. See each story's dependency links.
data.title: Implement Option A: ruleset-enforced fail-closed review gate on the two-tier flow
